title: Senior Backend Engineer (Kotlin)
text:
About the role
You will own services that process payments for merchants across Asia.

What you'll do
- Design and operate Kotlin/Spring Boot services on PostgreSQL
- Lead incident response and improve observability
- Mentor junior engineers

Requirements
- 5+ years building backend systems in Kotlin or Java
- Production experience with PostgreSQL
- Strong written communication in English

Nice to have
- Experience with event-driven architecture (Kafka)
- Payments or fintech background

About us
We are a 200-person company founded in 2015 with offices in Seoul and Singapore.
